dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Then it is as I thought! Though for Miss Bu the Fortune Teller, this was easy to discern.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: People like you I can read like a book... Ahem, I mean, it is easy to tell the fortunes of those such as yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: For example... I know that you hold many secrets in your mind... that you sometimes feel lonely... and that there is someone who holds a very special place in your heart...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could say that about anybody!

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Not so! These are specific truths I have clearly discerned about your individual fortune...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: ...I said too much in one go, didn't I?

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Lesson learnt. I'll know for next time.
